# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository uses [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) as the single source of truth for architecture, layout, code conventions, testing requirements, and workflow. The look & feel is in [crates/suite_common/src/ui/STYLE.md](../crates/suite_common/src/ui/STYLE.md).

When working in a specific plugin directory (`plugins/<plugin>/`), also refer to the plugin-specific `AGENTS.md` file (e.g. `plugins/amp/AGENTS.md`).
